Definition: Eshbaal (or Ishbosheth), a son of Saul
BiblicalUsage: ʼEshbaʻal was a son of Saul, also called Ishbosheth. The name occurs in 1 Chronicles. There is no People profile for this name, so this study covers the name's use only.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe ʼEshbaʻal matters because Scripture bothered to record the name. That is enough reason to slow down and notice the name rather than skip it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
